title: Web SSH Terminal
description: SSH into a server straight from your browser. Credentials are encrypted locally under a master password; the server stores and logs nothing.

privacy.title: Credentials stay between your browser and the target host
privacy.description: Passwords and keys are sent only in the connect frame, then dropped from memory once the session is up. Nothing is written to disk or logs. When you tick save, credentials are encrypted in your browser under your master password.

vault.unlockHint: Enter your master password to decrypt saved hosts. It is never stored anywhere — forget it and the vault has to be rebuilt.
vault.createHint: The master password encrypts your server credentials locally. You can also skip this and type credentials manually every time.
vault.wrongPassword: Wrong master password — the vault could not be decrypted
vault.destroy: Destroy local vault (erase all saved credentials)

form.remember: Save this host's credentials to the encrypted vault

terminal.needCredentials: Sessions restored after a refresh keep no password — reconnect from "New connection"

hostkey.title: Confirm host fingerprint
hostkey.description: This is the first connection to {{host}}:{{port}} — no host key fingerprint has been recorded yet.
hostkey.verifyHint: Verify it on the target with ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub. A mismatch may mean a man-in-the-middle.

errors.dns_failed: DNS lookup failed — check the hostname
errors.refused: Connection refused — check that SSH is running on that port
errors.timeout: Connection timed out — host unreachable or blocked by a firewall
errors.auth_failed: Authentication failed — check the username, password or key
errors.hostkey_mismatch: Host key fingerprint does not match the stored one. The server may have been rebuilt — or this may be a man-in-the-middle. Remove the stored fingerprint before reconnecting.
errors.too_many_sessions: You have reached the concurrent session limit — disconnect one first
errors.server_busy: The server has no free session slots — try again shortly
errors.locked_out: Too many failed authentications — temporarily locked out
errors.connect_timeout: Timed out waiting for the connect frame
errors.socket_error: Lost the connection to the gateway
errors.ws_unreachable: Cannot reach the terminal gateway — the upgrade request got no response. Check that the backend is running (pnpm dev / pnpm dev:full locally, pnpm start in production), and that any reverse proxy in front of it forwards WebSocket upgrades.
errors.gateway_timeout: The gateway accepted the connection but never answered — check the backend logs

closed.remote_closed: The remote end closed the session
